test_title: PYST 223: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 8th Dec,, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

I’m going to Mumbai next week. A __friend of myself__ has invited me to her wedding.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Friend of mine.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option that substitutes the underlined word is '**Friend of mine.'**
 
• One should use '**myself'** only while he is subject or **performing an action**.
